Launcher art elements are filled at runtime with data: URIs read in Rust; CSP default-src 'self' forbids the webview loading files, so they ship src-less and hidden by design (PRODUCT.md security model).

#rail-bar bands are flex siblings whose widths set each other's positions; scaleX cannot reposition a sibling, so there is no transform equivalent. They change on selection, not per frame. The one bar that does move continuously, #progress-fill, was converted to transform instead of ignored.
